messages.subject: error in R
parts:
Hello

I got this strange error message in R when trying to manipulate a time series data in R. My commands look like:
> DATA$Dates<-as.POSIXct(paste(DATA$Date, DATA$Time), format="%D.%m.%Y %H:%M:%S")
> DATA$groups<-cut.POSIXt(DATA$Dates, breaks="2 min")


and here is the error:

Error in seq.int(0, to0 - from, by) : 'to' cannot be NA, NaN or infinite
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In min.default(c(NA_real_, NA_real_, NA_real_, NA_real_, NA_real_,  :
  no non-missing arguments to min; returning Inf
2: In max.default(c(NA_real_, NA_real_, NA_real_, NA_real_, NA_real_,  :
  no non-missing arguments to max; returning -Inf

Help will be appreciated

messages.author: f4249b01b99d0091
messages.subject: Re: error in R
parts:
This is a listserv focused on ggplot, whereas your question is a more
general one about R. I'd suggest re-posting it on the main R help
listserv, or stackexchange, etc.

In any case: provide a reproducible example! That is, give some
(short) sample data to make your problem *reprodicible*. You're much
more likely to get help that way.

For what it's worth, it looks to me like you have a problem in your
input data, but without a sample to work with, that's just a guess.

Regards,
Ben
